summary: Immersion Corporation filed a Form 8-K on September 14, 2026, reporting fiscal fourth-quarter results for the period ended July 31, 2026, under Item 2.02, and separately disclosing under Item 8.01 that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.075 per share. The dividend is payable October 30, 2026, to stockholders of record as of October 16, 2026. The Board noted future dividends remain subject to review and potential adjustment or withdrawal under its capital allocation strategy. No advisor, transaction terms, or structural mechanics were disclosed; the filing is a routine earnings and dividend announcement, not a special situation.
